method: sweep.py scenarios --family <random family> (tools/bds-sweep/random_ticks.py): a 16 x 16 field of identical cells is laid out on the superflat floor without block updates (`build`, offsets from the field origin, the floor at y=-1), `randomtickspeed` is set to `speed`, and every `watch` position is read every `read_every` ticks; `reads` holds, per read, how many watched positions held each [block, states] (`minecraft:` left out). The replay test lays out the same field in unastar with a seeded random source and compares the histograms with a chi-square test.
